episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Arisu and his friends run into a public bathroom to hide from the police, but when they reemerge, the streets of Tokyo are suddenly completely empty.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Leaving an injured Chota, Arisu and Karube head out to gain more experience. They come to a sprawling apartment, where a deadly game of tag awaits.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: With Chota and Shibuki's visas fast expiring, the four enter a vast botanical garden in Shinjuku, where they take part in a cruel game of betrayal.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Arisu is overwhelmed with guilt and ready to give up, but Usagi urges him to keep going. Next up is a game of endurance in an underground highway.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: After Arisu and Usagi find their way to the Beach, the king of the so-called utopian haven forces them to help gather the remaining playing cards.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Chishiya recruits Arisu and Usagi to help him change the status quo. An unforeseen event rocks the fragile power dynamics of the Beach.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Once a safe haven, the Beach becomes the arena for the next stage, where an epic witch hunt turns everyone against each other in a hostile showdown.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Tensions inside the resort reach a boiling point. As the game clock nears zero, those who've survived the onslaught now face an uncertain future.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Arisu, Usagi, Kuina and Chishiya have been waiting for over an hour in Shibuya crossing for the next stage to start, but nothing seems to be happening.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Now that the King of Clubs has revealed himself in his full glory, the game finally begins. Much to Arisu's surprise, things are going pretty well.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: With only a few minutes left in the game, the results for each team seems fixed. Arisu approaches Kyuma, and asks to shake his hand.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: There are just a handful of players left, and Chishiya's the only one without a partner. The next round may very well be the last of the game.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Aguni has one thing on his mind; to find and kill the King of Spades. He's joined by Arisu and a determined high schooler named Akane Heiya.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Usagi will have to change the hearts and minds of the cynical players on the Queen's team. At the Supreme Court, Chishiya meets the King of Diamonds.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: In the middle of an overgrown Shibuya crossing, Niragi challenges Arisu and Chishiya to a game. But then, the King of Spades arrives.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: For their final game, they'll need to survive three rounds of croquet; but before they can get very far, the Queen asks them to sit down for some tea.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Back in the real world with no memories of Borderland, Arisu and Usagi encounter Ryuji, a professor with a fixation on near-death experiences.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: The first game begins at a shrine. Arisu and the other players must solve math problems on the fly before everything goes up in flames.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: As Rei's plan unravels, Arisu takes a risky move to keep his team alive. On a separate stage, Usagi and Ryuji face a relentless barrage of lasers.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: With time running out and a crash imminent, Usagi's group must jump trains to survive. An explosive game of Kick the Can awaits Arisu's team.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Arisu follows his digital double through a simulation of future Shibuya, stopping at a heartwarming scene — and the real Usagi before him.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Haunted by a devastating glimpse into the future, Arisu crumples under the pressure to save everyone. Will he, Usagi and the team make it to the exit?
